result.summary: The interface exhibits minor layout and content issues, primarily concerning navigation spacing and graphical consistency.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons are positioned too low, overlapping the system gesture indicator.
issues.suggestion: Implement bottom safe-area padding for the navigation bar.

issues.description: Restaurant cards utilize generic vector graphics with inconsistent art styles.
issues.suggestion: Adopt a unified style of high-quality food photography.

issues.description: Delivery costs are redundantly displayed in both card badges and metadata text.
issues.suggestion: Display delivery information only once per card to minimize clutter.
